busy: All run slots are busy ({limit}). Try again when a run has finished.
too_many_files: At most {limit} files can be attached to a run.
model_not_configured: No model is configured: set DEFAULT_MODEL or pass a model.
gateway_not_configured: The LLM gateway is not configured (LLM_GATEWAY_URL / LLM_API_KEY).
stream_limit: Too many live connections; close another view.
stream_failed: The live connection broke; the run is not restarted automatically.
run_failed: The run failed. No automatic retry was made.
run_timeout: The run reached its time limit.
run_orphaned: The worker disappeared; the run is not restarted automatically.
error_empty_result: The agent returned an empty result.
tool_limit: This run reached its tool-call limit.
web_unavailable: The remote service is unavailable or the response was refused.
search_unavailable: Search is unavailable; no results are claimed.
file_unreadable: The file cannot be read or has changed.
report_limit: The private output store is full.
upload_too_large: The file is too large (limit {limit} bytes).
schedule_missed: A scheduled run was skipped because it was more than 5 minutes late; it is not replayed.
schedule_consent_required: Scheduled runs call the model repeatedly and consume quota: set confirm_recurring_cost to true to enable.
agent_conflict: The agent was changed by someone else; reload it and apply your edit again.
schedule_start_failed: A scheduled run could not be started; it is not retried before the next occurrence.
schedule_required: Enabling a schedule needs a schedule.
agent_limit: At most 100 saved agents are allowed.
schedule_paused: Skipped: the model gateway was rate-limited recently, so scheduled starts are paused for a while. The skipped occurrence is not replayed.
error_rate_limited: The model gateway signalled a limit (rate limit or exhausted budget). This often lasts a while; do not restart immediately. No automatic retry was made.
error_gateway_request: The model gateway rejected the request (check the model name and parameters). No automatic retry was made; start the run again.
prompt_too_long: The prompt is longer than the allowed {limit} characters.
run_blocked_tool_errors: Repeated tool errors or invalid parameters stopped the run; no automatic retry was made.
files_total_too_large: The attached files together may be at most 10 MB.
error_gateway_unavailable: The model gateway was unreachable or timed out. No automatic retry was made; start the run again.
error_gateway_auth: The model gateway rejected the API key; fix the key, then start the run again. No automatic retry was made.
disk_low: Not enough free disk space to start a run safely.
memory_bad_key: A name is 1–80 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore, starting with a letter or digit.
memory_bad_revision: A write needs the previous revision (0 for a new name).
memory_bad_value: An entry may be at most 12,000 characters / 32 KB of text without control characters.
memory_request_id_reused: This operation id was already used with different content.
memory_conflict: The entry changed in the meantime. Read it again; do not overwrite blindly.
memory_already_deleted: The entry is already deleted or does not exist.
memory_keys_full: The knowledge base reached its limit of 200 names; an owner archive is needed.
memory_history_full: The knowledge-base history is full; nothing is deleted automatically, an owner archive is needed.
memory_inactive: The knowledge-base grant or the run is no longer active.
memory_unavailable: The shared knowledge base is unavailable. There is no file, SQL or shell substitute; read back an uncertain write before repeating it.
wf_graph_size: A graph has 2–12 nodes and at most 24 links.
wf_agent_id: An agent node needs a saved agent.
wf_agent_only: Only an agent node can reference a saved agent.
wf_condition: A condition can only be a fixed text check, never executable code.
wf_condition_only: Only a condition node can have a text check.
wf_endpoints: Exactly one start and one end, at most 8 agents.
wf_branch: Only a condition can have yes/no branches; every other link is always active.
wf_connectivity: Every node must be part of a path from the start to the end.
wf_degrees: At most 4 inputs and 3 outputs; a condition needs exactly one input and one yes and one no branch.
wf_cycle: A workflow cannot contain a cycle.
wf_duplicate_label: Two workflow steps have the same name: “{label}”. Give each a unique name.
wf_conflict: The workflow changed; reload it, do not overwrite the other edit.
wf_store_full: The workflow version store is full; an owner archive is needed.
wf_store_full_agent: The workflow version store is full. The agent and the workflows are unchanged; an owner archive is needed.
wf_agent_not_found: The selected saved agent was not found.
wf_prompt_long: A workflow agent's base prompt may be at most {limit} characters, to leave room for the passed-on input.
wf_agent_in_workflow_prompt: A workflow uses this agent: its base prompt may be at most {limit} characters.
wf_agent_invalid: A saved agent's tools, model or files are no longer valid.
wf_stale_version: The workflow was updated to a newer version or no longer exists. Reload the graph first.
wf_input_long: The workflow input may be at most {limit} characters.
wf_dataflow_required: Passing private data between the steps needs your explicit consent.
wf_schedule_consent: Recurring automatic runs need your explicit consent.
wf_active_limit: At most three workflows can be active; ones waiting for approval count too.
wf_runs_full: The workflow run store is full.
wf_not_active: The workflow is no longer active or has expired.
wf_approval_inactive: This approval is no longer active.
wf_controller_active: The controller is still active; no parallel controller is started.
wf_sched_deleted: The workflow was deleted; its schedule stopped.
wf_sched_version: The workflow was updated to a new version; approve the schedule again.
wf_err_timeout: The workflow reached its time limit; it is not re-run automatically.
wf_err_blocked: An agent's business outcome is blocked or in error: the task is not verified as fulfilled. No automatic retry.
wf_err_generic: The workflow failed, expired or a step was rejected. No automatic retry; check the steps and permissions.
wf_err_rejected: The owner did not approve continuing the workflow.
wf_err_stopped: The workflow was interrupted or expired.
wf_err_agent_gone: A frozen agent permission or file is no longer valid.
wf_err_child_missing: The workflow's agent run was not found.
wf_err_uncertain_launch: Uncertain agent launch; it is not retried automatically.
wf_err_input_no_room: There is no room for the safely marked workflow input.
wf_err_structured_no_room: The structured workflow input does not fit completely; truncated JSON is not passed on. Narrow the task.
wf_err_too_many_waits: A step reached too many wait points.
